chapter.title: Ship Goals
chapter.summary: Ships worth saving for, with live UEX prices. Pick the ones that fit your career.

objectives.title: Buy an Aegis Avenger Titan
objectives.why: A one-seat ship with an 8 SCU cargo grid: small hauls and early bounties in one ship.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.

objectives.title: Buy a Drake Cutlass Black
objectives.why: 46 SCU of cargo, room for up to 3 crew and a built-in tractor beam.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.

objectives.title: Buy a MISC Freelancer MAX
objectives.why: 120 SCU of cargo, flyable solo: a big step up for Covalex Member and Experienced hauls.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.

objectives.title: Buy a MISC Prospector
objectives.why: A one-seat mining ship. Recco Battaglia also gives one at Prestige 2.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.

objectives.title: Buy an ARGO MOLE
objectives.why: A crewed mining ship (up to 5 crew). Recco Battaglia also gives one at Prestige 3.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.

objectives.title: Buy a Crusader C2 Hercules Starlifter
objectives.why: 696 SCU of cargo for the biggest hauls; flyable by 1-2 crew.

steps.do: Save up the price shown above.
Buy it at the cheapest listed shop.
steps.done_when: It is listed as yours at an ASOP terminal.
